headline: Accenture (ACN) Following UniCredit Deal And IBM Tie Up Has A Valuation Split
summary: Accenture (ACN) is back in focus after UniCredit announced a long term collaboration with Accenture and IBM that includes Accenture acquiring a majority stake in the bank’s technology infrastructure joint venture. See our latest analysis for Accenture. Accenture’s latest banking technology deal comes after a series of AI related client wins, yet the stock tells a mixed story.
